questions.question: What was the total state tax revenue collected in Connecticut during June 2026?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('ct_tax_revenue_by_month.csv')
row = df[(df['Calendar Year'] == 2026) & (df['Month'] == 'June')]
result = float(row['Total Revenue'].iloc[0])

questions.question: In calendar year 2012, between withholding taxes and sales and use taxes, which source generated more total revenue?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('ct_tax_revenue_by_month.csv')
df_2012 = df[df['Calendar Year'] == 2012]
withholding_total = df_2012['Withholding'].sum()
sales_total = df_2012['Sales and Use'].sum()
result = 'Withholding' if withholding_total > sales_total else 'Sales and Use'

questions.question: Did any month in the records see revenue from the cigarette tax drop below two million dollars?

questions.question: What was the total revenue collected from the admissions and dues tax in fiscal year 2011-12?

questions.question: Which calendar year recorded the highest overall tax revenue across all months reported?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('ct_tax_revenue_by_month.csv')
yearly = df.groupby('Calendar Year')['Total Revenue'].sum()
result = str(yearly.idxmax())
